$schema: informal — briefing profile for an LLM picking up the Random Tattoo Studio build
how_to_use: Paste this whole file as the first message of a new chat, then state the next request. It encodes the project, the hard constraints, the conventions, and the traps already discovered. Treat 'hard_constraints' and 'standing_instructions' as non-negotiable unless the client overrides them explicitly.

project.what: Marketing website for a custom tattoo studio in Belgrade, Serbia. Three artists, appointment/consultation driven.
project.language_of_site: Serbian (Latin script, with full diacritics: š đ č ć ž)
project.language_of_client: Serbian. The client writes informally, often without diacritics, in rapid-fire short messages. Reply in Serbian.
project.framework_context: Lives inside the WAT framework (Workflows / Agents / Tools) — see c:/Users/pavle/Downloads/CLAUDE.md. Workflows in workflows/, Python tools in tools/, secrets ONLY in .env, .tmp/ is disposable.

git.IMPORTANT_repo_root_is_site_not_Random: The git repository root is Random/site/ — NOT Random/. Running git from Random/ fails with 'not a git repository'. cd into Random/site first.

standing_instructions.rule: DESKTOP-FIRST — every request the client makes is for the desktop version unless they explicitly say 'za telefon'.
standing_instructions.why: The client does not want to repeat each request for both breakpoints.
standing_instructions.how: Apply the request literally on desktop. Then adapt the mobile version YOURSELF so it stays aesthetic, legible and nice. Do not ask 'should I wrap it on mobile?' — decide, do it, and mention it in one sentence. Example precedent: the footer slogan is one nowrap line on desktop but wraps to 4 balanced lines at 24px on phones, because one line would have required a ~7px font at 390px.

standing_instructions.why: The client has asked for a push after essentially every single edit all session.
standing_instructions.how: cd Random/site && git add -A && git commit && git push origin main. Report the short SHA.

standing_instructions.rule: VERIFY, DON'T ASSUME. Measure before claiming something is fixed.
standing_instructions.why: The client has caught wrong 'fixed it' claims and reacted harshly ('sta si tacno sredio majmuncino', 'NISI RESIO, POGLEDAAAAAAAJ'). Twice I misdiagnosed the torn-divider bug.

standing_instructions.rule: Never create or overwrite workflow .md files without asking.
Secrets live ONLY in .env. credentials.json / token.json are gitignored Google OAuth files.

hard_constraints.stack: VANILLA ONLY — HTML + CSS + JS. NO framework, NO build step, NO npm, NO JSX. This is absolute.
hard_constraints.consequence: The client frequently pastes React/Next component code (from 21st.dev, Framer, Aceternity-style libraries) and says 'I want this'. You must RECREATE it natively in vanilla JS/CSS/WebGL. Never install it, never introduce React.
hard_constraints.how_libs_were_added: curl from jsdelivr into site/vendor/. No package manager.
hard_constraints.corners: SHARP — border-radius: 0 across the brand. Do not round things.
hard_constraints.colors_never: NEVER purple. Every ported shader/background must be recolored into brand tokens and must stay SUBTLE — the client repeatedly says 'ne mnogo upadljivo' and 'nase boje i nas stil'.

fonts.mono: Space Mono — used for labels, pills, footer bottom bar

brand.note_on_black: #000 vs --soot #0E0B0A is nearly imperceptible. When the client says a section 'isn't black', pure black won't help — use `isolation: isolate` plus hairline top/bottom borders to make the boundary legible. This exact confusion already happened on the Proces section.

custom_components_built.StaggeredMenu: Ported from a React component to vanilla + gsap. Replaced the old .nav-overlay. Present on index.html, artist.html, galerija.html. Markup: .sm > .sm-prelayers (clay + ember layers) + .sm-panel with .sm-list[data-numbering] and .sm-socials.
custom_components_built.ethereal_zone: One shared background spanning the 'Ovo ostaje zauvek' assemble section + '#recenzije' + the stats row. .ethereal-zone holds .reviews-bg which uses an SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap + feColorMatrix(hueRotate) filter (#ethereal-shadow) driven by JS setAttribute. The shape is a solid brand color MASKED by assets/ethereal-mask.png — this is the faithful recreation; radial-gradient blobs were rejected by the client as 'ni ne lici'.
custom_components_built.torn_dividers: The jagged top/bottom edges of .ethereal-zone. Implemented as a clip-path: polygon() ON THE ZONE ITSELF (mixed %, px and calc(100% - Npx) units for the mirrored bottom edge). Reference: the 20/44 project's TornDivider.tsx, seed 4423. A separate soot SVG band was the WRONG approach and caused a black-gap bug — do not reintroduce it.
custom_components_built.plasma_threads: WebGL shader background pinned in the Proces section (initProcShader). Recolored to brand, threads made thin/sparse/subtle at the client's insistence.
custom_components_built.spooky_smoke: WebGL shader in the Artisti section (initArtistiShader).
custom_components_built.footer_wordmark: Giant RANDOM using background-clip: text with 5 layered tattoo images positioned into specific letters (R, A, middle, O, M) + a linear-gradient(bone,bone) base so the rest of the letters read as near-white. Behind it sits .footer__ghost — a huge near-invisible RANDOM in #1b1512. Positions were tuned letter-by-letter at the client's direction; do not casually reflow them.
custom_components_built.LocationMap: The .lmap component in the contact aside — custom stylized map card, expands on click. 'Pogledaj mapu →' link.
custom_components_built.button_corner_markers: .btn__corner elements that change color and move INSIDE the button on hover; arrow turns black on hover.
custom_components_built.bottom_blur: .bottom-blur — progressive blur strip at the bottom of the viewport, appears only while scrolling and disappears at the footer. z-index 90.
custom_components_built.circular_cta: .circular-cta / .circular-progress — reparented to document.body as fixed elements so they can sit above .bottom-blur.

known_gotchas.symptom:
text-align: center on a

appears to do nothing — the paragraph box shrinks to the text width and sits left.
known_gotchas.fix: Set max-width: none (and margin-inline: auto) on that paragraph. This exact bug hit .footer__slogan.

known_gotchas.trap: #glavni has z-index: 2, creating a stacking context.
known_gotchas.symptom: No descendant of #glavni can ever rise above the sibling .bottom-blur (z-index 90), no matter its z-index.
known_gotchas.fix: Reparent the element to document.body as position: fixed. Done for .circular-cta / .circular-progress.

known_gotchas.trap: html, body { overflow-x: clip } — must be `clip`, NOT `hidden`.
known_gotchas.why: overflow: hidden breaks position: sticky throughout the page.

known_gotchas.trap: Per-character inline-block spans in animated headings wrap mid-word.
known_gotchas.symptom: A stray letter (famously an 'A') orphaned on its own line.
known_gotchas.fix: white-space: nowrap on .assemble-line. On mobile also AMT = soft ? (isMobile ? 0 : 14) : 50 in initAssemble so headings don't spread past the screen.

known_gotchas.detail: `.nav__cta > * { position: relative }` overrides `.btn__corner { position: absolute }`, and overflow: hidden clips them. The client reacted strongly when this broke. The ethereal background experiment on the nav CTA was reverted entirely — the nav button is back to its original state.

known_gotchas.trap: Long nav CTA text breaks the tablet nav around 760px (logo overlaps links, button wraps).
known_gotchas.fix: white-space: nowrap plus a @media (min-width: 712px) and (max-width: 1040px) compaction block.

verification_methodology.why_this_exists: Headless Chrome screenshots repeatedly produced FALSE conclusions and wasted long stretches of the session, including a phantom overflow chase.
headless_traps: Headless Chrome CANNOT render below ~500px CSS viewport width. A 360px or 390px screenshot is really a CROP of a 500px layout — it will lie to you about mobile.
--virtual-time-budget does NOT advance CSS transitions or gsap timelines.
Hash-anchor scrolling (#section) does not work in headless.
Below-the-fold .reveal content is opacity: 0, so it photographs as blank.
verification_methodology.the_reliable_method: Build an isolated _test.html / _f.html page in site/ that pulls in styles.css and only the markup fragment under test (extract it from index.html with a small python heredoc). Then EITHER screenshot it, OR — better for layout facts — run a DOM probe that writes measurements into document.title and read them back with --dump-dom | grep '<title>'. Delete the temp page afterwards.
verification_methodology.worked_example: To prove the footer slogan was centered: probe wrote `levo=` and `desno=` gaps between the paragraph box and the parent's content edges, plus fontSize, line count, and an overflow boolean; then loop the same probe across window sizes 1600/1400/900/712/560.
verification_methodology.charset_gotcha: If you build a temp page and forget <meta charset="utf-8">, Serbian diacritics render as mojibake (koÅ¾i). That is an artifact of YOUR test page, not a site bug — the real index.html has the meta tag. Don't chase it.

client_working_style.cadence: Very rapid, short, section-by-section messages. Often sends a new instruction mid-turn while you're still working — address it in the same turn.
client_working_style.tone: Blunt. Will call you out hard if you claim a fix that isn't real. They value being shown the actual cause, not a hand-wave.
client_working_style.what_they_reward: Diagnosing the real root cause and stating it plainly (e.g. 'the global p { max-width: 62ch } was shrinking the box'), and measuring instead of guessing.
client_working_style.what_irritates_them: Repeating a wrong fix, asking questions they've already implicitly answered, and asking about mobile when they've said mobile is your job.
client_working_style.reply_style_that_works: Serbian, lead with what changed, one short paragraph of why if something was subtle, then the commit SHA. Tables only for real enumerable data like the measurement grid.
